source: Yahoo Finance chart API adjusted close

model.hedge_ratio: rolling OLS of log(GLD) on log(SLV)
model.z_score: current rolling regression residual divided by in-window residual standard deviation
model.entry: short spread at z >= 2; long spread at z <= -2
model.execution: signal and hedge ratio shifted one trading day

full_sample_diagnostic_only.warning: This full-sample diagnostic uses future observations and is not used for trading signals. It is not a formal cointegration test.

evidence_boundary: GLD and SLV are ETF proxies from a secondary provider; they are not spot or futures gold/silver series.
The rolling rule is one pre-specified illustrative model, not a multiple-testing-corrected strategy search.
No formal Engle-Granger/Johansen test, borrow fee, financing, tax, spread, market impact, ETF fee beyond provider adjustments, or intraday execution model is included.
The negative result is retained as local evidence that correlation and a high trade win rate do not guarantee profitable mean reversion.
